task.subject: A pull-request review remediation workflow for the githubnext/gh-aw-cao repository
task.intent: Determine whether the pull-request review remediation workflow activates on review-requested pull requests, produces bounded remediation pull requests when evidence supports action, and attains its intended value of converting review requests into accepted remediation outcomes.
activationConditions: A repository operator enables a standalone pull-request review remediation workflow on githubnext/gh-aw-cao.
A pull request in githubnext/gh-aw-cao enters a review-requested state that creates one stable remediation opportunity for the workflow.
A workflow run associated with that pull-request remediation opportunity is observed within the dashboard horizon.
requiredEffects: For each eligible review-requested pull request opportunity, the workflow evaluates the review context and emits at most one safe pull-request output proposing remediation or an evidence-backed no-op.
Accepted repository evidence must remain limited to the emitted pull-request outcome, the producing workflow run provenance, and any same-opportunity finding evidence.
The workflow must leave already-remediated, ineligible, or duplicate review opportunities without a new durable output.
noopConditions: The pull request is already closed, merged, or no longer awaiting review remediation before evaluation.
The review request lacks the minimum changed files or review evidence needed for a bounded remediation proposal.
A prior accepted workflow output already covers the same pull-request remediation opportunity.
successConditions: The workflow activates for eligible review-requested pull-request opportunities within the selected horizon.
Observed durable outputs for eligible opportunities are accepted remediation pull requests or intentional no-ops with matching evidence strength and run provenance.
Operational-grader observations preserve the ordered native metric published by gh-aw for each workflow run.
uncertainties: A completed run does not by itself prove the emitted remediation pull request was accepted.
Pending, rejected, or ignored outputs do not establish attained remediation readiness.
A null operational-grader metric must remain distinct from a numeric zero.

operationalValue.preservation: Preserve metric IDs, order, native finite values or null, units, and directions exactly as published by gh-aw.

opportunity.stability: One stable opportunity exists per review-requested pull request until the request is remediated, closed, or superseded.
evidence: workflow run provenance for the remediation opportunity
safe-output outcome records in the outcomes source
linked finding evidence for the same repository, workflow, and run when present

maturation.rule: An observation is mature when the workflow run has produced a terminal outcome state of accepted, rejected, ignored, lifecycle, or lifecycle-close for the bound remediation opportunity.

operationalValue.zeroRule: Assign 0 only when accepted repository evidence shows the eligible remediation opportunity reached a terminal non-attained outcome without an accepted remediation output.
operationalValue.missingEvidenceRule: Return null when repository evidence is absent, incomplete, or only shows workflow execution without an attributable remediation outcome.
